scope: Bounded source and fixture audit for normal GCC CLI interruption, retained checkpoint lineage, and same-owner resume. This record does not qualify a real compiler run, process containment, or production release.

sourceObservations.criterion: The normal CLI selects the contained GCC owner and exposes checkpoint interruption/resume in one invocation.
sourceObservations.detail: gcc-engine-plan calls GccBundledCliCommand.run. A selected checkpoint calls executeUntilCheckpoint and then resume on the same prepared owner before plan and result publication; the help text says this is within one process and is not cold recovery.

sourceObservations.criterion: The interruption path retains an ordered prefix and stopped analysis-state manifest before resume preparation.
sourceObservations.detail: The coordinator captures the interrupted export prefix, validates it after containment absence, captures the state directory, and journals interruption authorization, interrupted execution, prefix assessment, manifest, and captured-state summary in that order.

sourceObservations.criterion: Resume is bound to the retained owner, state manifest, prior inputs, prior control identity, and a distinct resumed execution chain.
sourceObservations.detail: Revalidation rejects changed retained state, prefix, in-flight fragments, or inputs. Resume requires the retained owner, uses RESUME_MANIFEST state and invocation version 4, protects the prior control/state, and records resume preparation, attachment, START authorization, execution, and export assessment with predecessor bindings.

sourceObservations.criterion: Planning consumes the owner-bound resumed export and preserves containment absence checks.
sourceObservations.detail: plan requires this owner's completed export, re-captures the model before planner START, binds the planner request to the operation/profile/model identities, and records planner execution and assessment only after unit, cgroup, and process absence.
